scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/frontend && npm run build --prefix apps/runners/orchestrator
scripts.start:e2e:services: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; docker compose up -d postgres pubsub
scripts.show:e2e-report: npm exec --prefix apps/frontend playwright -- show-report apps/frontend/playwright-report
scripts.test:e2e:mock: npm run start:e2e:services && npm run build:e2e:orchestrator && PLAYRUNNER_E2E_MODE=mock npm run e2e --prefix apps/frontend --
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run start:e2e:services && npm run build:e2e:orchestrator && PLAYRUNNER_E2E_MODE=live npm run e2e --prefix apps/frontend --
